label: Yellow
source_name: Visit Panama City Beach / Beach & Surf Patrol
method: Direct official current-condition terminology normalized under Florida Beach Warning Flag definitions
note: last_verified_at is the most recent successful Know the Gulf poll. status_changed_at is when Know the Gulf first observed the current flag status. Polling time is not guaranteed to equal the exact official issuance time.
flag_schema: Florida Beach Warning Flag terminology v1
flag_terms_note: Official current wording is normalized as: Water Closed to Public=Double Red; High Hazard or High Surf and/or Currents=Red; Medium/Moderate Hazard or Moderate Surf and/or Currents=Yellow; Low Hazard or Calm Conditions, Exercise Caution=Green; Dangerous Marine Life=Purple. Purple is an independent overlay. Forecast rip-current risk is not converted into a flag. Generic current-text evidence is bounded before legend, warning, rules, FAQ, and safety-education sections.
